May 15, 1936. Afternoon Translation

Ta Kung Pao:

MADAME SUN YAT SEN INDISPOSED

It is learned that Madame Sun Yat Sen was suffering from appendicitis at the end of last month. She was immediately rushed by her family to a certain sanatorium and underwent an operation.

According to information received yesterday from her home, Madame Sun is now out of all danger and is progressing satisfactorily.

At the time when Madame Sun underwent the operation, Madame Liao Chun Kai, nee Ho Shiang Nyi (何香凝), ex-member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, personally paid a visit to Madame Sun. Unexpectedly, during her visit Madame Liao had a bad heart attack and she was detained in the hospital. According to the doctors, Madame Liao will not be able to leave the hospital until after she has undergone medical treatment for a period of 100 days.

Shih Tai Pao (時代報) publishes the following comment (brief translation):

"BLOOD & IRON" METHODS TO DEAL WITH JAPANESE IN NORTH CHINA

Based on reports received from Peiping, the Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury published yesterday an article to the effect that a certain Japanese building construction firm, engaged in repairing and building Japanese army barracks at Kupeikow Pass, Great Wall, were removing and using a large quantity of bricks from the ancient structure, with or without the permission of the Chinese authorities.

The Great Wall is the inheritance of our ancestors. If based on the Tangpu Truce, Kupeikow Pass is also not a place where soldiers are allowed to be stationed and barracks to be built up at random. However, soldiers have now been stationed at the Pass and the construction of the barracks has been completed. Chinese people should therefore realize the situation and make immediately "blood and iron" preparations to meet it.

World Morning News (世界晨報):

LOCAL SALE OF APHRODISIACS

Of late, aphrodisiacs such as "Pei Lin Sun" (貝林孫), etc. have been on sale in the market. These medicines are liable to cause injury to public health.

It is understood that the health authorities have paid close attention to this matter and will ask for assistance of the police force to place a strict ban upon these medicines.

1936年5月15日。下午译件

《大公报》：

宋庆龄夫人身体不适

据悉，宋庆龄夫子上月底患阑尾炎。家属随即将其紧急送往某疗养院施行手术。

据昨日从其寓所得到的消息，宋夫人目前已脱离危险，恢复情况良好。

在宋夫人接受手术时，国民党前中央执行委员廖仲恺夫人，即何香凝女士（Ho Shiang Nyi），曾亲自前往探视。不料，廖夫人在探视期间突发严重心脏病，被留院治疗。据医生称，廖夫人需经过一百天的治疗后，方可出院。

《时代报》（Shih Tai Pao）发表如下评论（简要翻译）：

以“铁血”手段对付华北日军

根据来自北平的报告，《上海晚邮报与信使报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury）昨日刊登一篇文章，称一家日本建筑公司在修复和修建古北口长城沿线的日军兵营时，无论是否获得中国当局许可，均拆除并使用了大量古建筑砖块。

长城乃我祖先之遗产。即便依据《塘沽协定》，古北口亦非允许随意驻军及修建兵营之地。然而，如今该关口已驻扎军队，兵营建设也已完工。因此，国人应认清局势，立即做好“铁血”准备以应对之。

《世界晨报》（World Morning News）：

本地出售春药

近期，市场上有“贝林孙”（Pei Lin Sun）等春药出售。此类药品易损害公众健康。

据悉，卫生当局已密切关注此事，并将请求警方协助，对这些药品实施严格禁令。
